name: Frontier Finance
tagline: A gamified finance app with ML stock charts and AI suggestions, built solo on many sponsor tools.

awards: MLH || Best Use of Solana || Ledger Nano S Plus

problem: The builder wanted to learn production-grade architecture while making finance engaging.
solution: Combines a portfolio view, ML predictions, AI financial suggestions, on-chain payments and checkout in one containerised stack.
demo_moment: Team-described: view predictions and buy through checkout.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH || Best Use of Solana || Ledger Nano S Plus” among 231 submissions.
A solo stretch across many unfamiliar technologies.

lessons: Breadth can win a single-sponsor prize when that sponsor is used well.
